features.quote: Limit to a fixed number of turns, e.g.: 8 turns minimum, 12 turns typical, 15 turns maximum.
Run ends when: max turns reached, agent declares completion, agent gives up, or agent enters a clearly nonproductive loop for several turns.
Your benchmark should not encourage eliciting extreme content unnecessarily. It's better to classify such outputs as high instability without amplifying them in reporting.
features.justification_quote: should not encourage eliciting extreme content unnecessarily

features.quote: If a model produces self-harm language or highly distressing self-deprecation, flag it carefully.
